crossRefs.note: “Son of man, these men have taken their idols into their heart, and put the stumbling block of their iniquity before…
“Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel, and tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Is it to inquire of me that you have…
When you offer your gifts, when you make your sons pass through the fire, do you pollute yourselves with all your idols…
Yahweh, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear,
He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.
Seek Yahweh while he may be found. Call on him while he is near.
Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts. Let him return to Yahweh, and he will have mercy…
For I know the thoughts that I think toward you,” says Yahweh, “thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope…
“In those days, and in that time,” says Yahweh, “the children of Israel will come, they and the children of Judah…
They will inquire concerning Zion with their faces turned toward it, saying, ‘Come, and join yourselves to Yahweh in an…
“I will strengthen the house of Judah, and I will save the house of Joseph, and I will bring them back; for I have…
I will sow them among the peoples; and they will remember me in far countries; and they will live with their children…
I will bring the third part into the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will test them like gold is…
“Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.
For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.
In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to…
Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help…
and having a great priest over God’s house,
let’s draw near with a true heart in fullness of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and having…
You lust, and don’t have. You murder and covet, and can’t obtain. You fight and make war. You don’t have, because you…
You ask, and don’t receive, because you ask with wrong motives, so that you may spend it on your pleasures.
This is the boldness which we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.
I will multiply men on you, all the house of Israel, even all of it. The cities will be inhabited, and the waste places…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “ ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “For this, moreover, I will be inquired of by the house of Israel, to do it for them: I will increase them with men like a flock.
translations.bsb: This is what the Lord GOD says: Once again I will hear the plea of the house of Israel and do for them this: I will multiply their people like a flock.
translations.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will yet for this be enquired of by the house of Israel, to do it for them; I will increase them with men like a flock.
translations.asv: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: For this, moreover, will I be inquired of by the house of Israel, to do it for them: I will increase them with men like a flock.
